Added by the 74th Amendment.

Contains 18 subjects such as:
• Urban planning
• Regulation of land use
• Water supply
• Public health
• Fire services
• Urban poverty alleviation

items: The Twelfth Schedule was added by the 74th Amendment (do not confuse with the 11th Schedule added by the 73rd Amendment).
The Twelfth Schedule contains 18 subjects, whereas the Eleventh Schedule contains 29 subjects.
Exams often ask specific subjects listed under Municipalities, such as Fire Services, Urban Poverty Alleviation, and Public Health.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Twelfth Schedule was added to the Constitution via the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act.
It defines the powers, authority, and responsibilities of Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities).
It specifies 18 specific subjects including urban planning, public health, water supply, and fire services.
Urban poverty alleviation and regulation of land use are key welfare components listed in this schedule.
